answers.question: Which transcription endpoint should be used: OpenAI Whisper API, Deepgram API, local Whisper on Jetson Orin, or local Whisper on RTX 3090?
answers.context: Four options with different trade-offs. OpenAI Whisper API is recommended for MVP simplicity (~$0.006/min). Deepgram offers speed. Jetson Orin provides free processing with medium model. RTX 3090 rig can run large-v3 for highest quality. Decision affects cost, latency, and offline capability.
answers.selected_answer: OpenAI Whisper API for MVP, with abstraction layer to swap later

answers.question: Which LLM should be used for classification: Claude API (Sonnet), local LLM on RTX 3090, or OpenAI GPT-4o-mini?
answers.context: Classification quality directly impacts the >80% accuracy goal. Claude Sonnet is positioned as cost/quality balance. Local LLM eliminates API costs but may have lower accuracy. GPT-4o-mini is another hosted option.

answers.question: Do you want a notification or haptic confirmation when the file is successfully saved to Google Drive?
answers.context: The iOS Shortcut has an optional haptic confirmation step. This confirms the handoff worked but adds slight friction to the fire-and-forget experience. Without it, no immediate feedback that capture was queued.

answers.question: What is the preferred notification method: Pushover, email, Slack/Discord webhook, or iOS Shortcuts webhook?
answers.context: Notifications needed for processing failures and daily summaries. Pushover is recommended ($5 one-time) for simplicity and reliability. Email may get buried. Slack/Discord requires existing workspace.

answers.question: Should tasks sync only to Notion, or also to Apple Reminders or Todoist?
answers.context: Voice-captured tasks currently flow only to Notion. Syncing to a dedicated task manager provides native reminders, widgets, and due date notifications. However, adds complexity and potential sync conflicts. Notion-only keeps system simpler but requires manually checking Notion for tasks.
answers.selected_answer: Notion-only for MVP, evaluate sync later

answers.question: Should the Voice Captures system create a new dedicated Notion area or integrate into an existing workspace structure?
answers.context: System needs Voice Captures database and Weekly Summaries location. Dedicated area keeps captures isolated and organized. Integration may provide better cross-referencing but requires understanding current workspace.

answers.question: Should all templates share a single Notion database with a Type property, or use separate databases per template?
answers.context: Single database is simpler to query and maintain, uses Type property to distinguish templates. Separate databases allow template-specific views and properties but complicate cross-template queries and weekly synthesis.

sections: Appendix B: Just Press Record Settings
answers.question: Should Just Press Record use M4A or WAV format for recordings?
answers.context: M4A (AAC) is compressed and smaller, reducing sync time and storage. WAV is lossless but larger. For speech transcription, M4A quality is typically sufficient and Whisper handles both.
answers.selected_answer: Use native Just Press Record format (M4A default) — no configuration change needed
